source_text: Rebecca egreditur, haurit, camelos etiam potat. Signum orationis impletur. Inaures et armillae — ornamenta animae obedientis.
pass_a_gloss: Rebecca goes-out, draws, camels also she-waters. Sign of-prayer is-fulfilled. Earrings and bracelets — ornaments of-soul obedient.
pass_b_english: [[Rebecca comes out, draws water, and waters the camels too >> Bible:Genesis 24:15-20]]. The prayer’s sign is fulfilled. Earrings and bracelets — ornaments of an obedient soul.
